# Template variables in anchor hrefs are open redirects unless url_for.
# ruleid: var-in-href
<a href = "{{ userUrl }}" >profile</a>
# ruleid: var-in-href
<a href = '{{ nextUrl }}' >next</a>
# ok: var-in-href
<a href = "{{ url_for('home')  }}" >home</a>
# ok: var-in-href
<a href = "/static/site.css" >css</a>
